# Supported hardware

hk-dsl builds kernels for four GPU architectures. This page is generated from the code that decides what runs where: the target table (`python/hk/target/`), the engine-route table (`python/hk/integration/switches.py`) and the runners of CI's GPU tier (`.github/workflows/gpu.yml`). `tests/hk/ir/test_hardware_docs.py` fails when the page and the code disagree.

## GPUs

| GPU | arch | status | engine routes on by default |
|---|---|---|---|
| Radeon PRO W7900, Radeon PRO W7900D, Radeon RX 7900 | gfx1100 (RDNA3) | **runs**: measured on Radeon PRO W7900D; CI's GPU tier runs on one | 9: vLLM 4, SGLang 2, SGLang-Diffusion 2, `hk.ops` 1 |
| Radeon AI PRO R9700, Radeon RX 9070 | gfx1201 (RDNA4) | **runs**: measured on Radeon AI PRO R9700; CI's GPU tier runs on one | 3: vLLM 3 |
| Instinct MI300X, Instinct MI325X | gfx942 (CDNA3) | **compile-only**: no part was available, so its numbers are modelled from the compiler. CI builds kernels for it; none has run on one | none |
| Instinct MI355X, Instinct MI350X | gfx950 (CDNA4) | **runs**: measured on Instinct MI355X; CI's GPU tier runs on one | 5: vLLM 5 |

Other GPUs are not supported, other RDNA3 parts (gfx1101, gfx1102) included. On one, `hk.target.current_arch()` builds for gfx1100, and every engine route is off by default. `HK_ARCH` names the arch to build for, as a gfx name or as one of `CDNA3`, `CDNA4`, `RDNA3`, `RDNA4`, `gfx11`, `gfx12`.

## What the language has on each

| | gfx1100 | gfx1201 | gfx942 | gfx950 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| lanes a wave | 32 | 32 | 64 | 64 |
| `hk.mma` input types (the target's `mma` table) | bf16, fp16, i8 | bf16, fp16, i8, fp8e4m3, fp8e5m2 | bf16, fp16 | bf16, fp16, fp8e4m3 |
| register strips (`hk.RS`), and so `hk.templates.elementwise` / `rowwise` | yes | yes | no | yes |
| global -> LDS without passing through VGPRs (`g.load(..., wait=False)`) | no | no | yes | yes |
| tile fragment shapes (`hk.RT(..., frag=...)`) | no | no | no | yes |

gfx950 also has the block-scaled matrix ops (`hk.mma_ABt_mx`: FP8 e4m3 and FP4 operands with E8M0 scales, its `v_mfma_scale` instruction), and `hk.comm`'s hand-offs were measured on gfx950 only; neither is in the target table. The numbers behind the table (registers, LDS, granules, and where each was measured) are in [`hk.target`](api/hk.target.md).

## Engine routes on each

A route is on by default only on the GPUs it was validated on (**on** below). Elsewhere it is off: its switch at `1` turns it on anyway, without that validation, and not every route's kernels exist on every arch. A route marked opt-in is off on every GPU until you turn it on. What each route does and the evidence for its default: [integration](integration.md#on-by-default-and-turning-it-off); `python3 -m hk.integration --status` prints the decision on your machine.

| route | engine | switch | gfx1100 | gfx1201 | gfx942 | gfx950 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `vllm_mxfp8` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_MXFP8` | off | off | off | **on** |
| `vllm_moe_a8w4` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_MOE_A8W4` | off | off | off | **on** |
| `vllm_dsv41_index` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_DSV41_INDEX` | off | off | off | **on** |
| `vllm_sparse_mla` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_SPARSE_MLA` | off | off | off | **on** |
| `vllm_int4` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_INT4` | **on** | **on** | off | **on** |
| `vllm_gptq` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_GPTQ` | opt-in | opt-in | opt-in | opt-in |
| `vllm_gemm` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_GEMM` | **on** | **on** | off | off |
| `vllm_moe` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_MOE` | **on** | **on** | off | off |
| `vllm_sdpa` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_SDPA` | **on** | off | off | off |
| `vllm_backend` | vLLM | `HK_VLLM_BACKEND` | opt-in | opt-in | opt-in | opt-in |
| `sglang_linear` | SGLang | `HK_SGLANG_LINEAR` | **on** | off | off | off |
| `sglang_moe` | SGLang | `HK_SGLANG_MOE` | **on** | off | off | off |
| `sgld_attn` | SGLang-Diffusion | `HK_SGLD_ATTN` | **on** | off | off | off |
| `sgld_linear` | SGLang-Diffusion | `HK_SGLD_LINEAR` | **on** | off | off | off |
| `sgld_convrot` | SGLang-Diffusion | `HK_SGLD_CONVROT` | opt-in | opt-in | opt-in | opt-in |
| `sdpa_k3` | `hk.ops` | `HK_SDPA_K3` | **on** | off | off | off |
